audit_md:
# Website Health Check: Crystal Smiles (formerly No Tears Dental)

## What we saw on 13 November 2026

- The practice is open: Google shows Crystal Smiles LLC, Dentist, 65 Rues Ln, East Brunswick, NJ 08816, (732) 257-4444, rated 4.8 - and no website link, only an "Add website" prompt.
- crystalsmilesnj.com, still listed as its website by a business directory, now redirects to the domain reseller HugeDomains, which offers the name for sale.
- notearsdental.com, still linked from the practice's Nextdoor page, shows a GoDaddy "parked free" page with a "Get This Domain" button and unrelated search links.
- Archives show the practice's real site (same phone, services and insurance pages) at crystalsmilesnj.com through December 2022; no current site was found.

## What it means for customers

A patient who clicks the website link on Nextdoor or a directory reaches a parking or for-sale page instead of the office, so hours, services and accepted insurance cannot be checked before calling. Everything then depends on the phone, including the name change from No Tears Dental.

## How to fix it

1. Check who holds both domain accounts, and whether crystalsmilesnj.com can be bought back or notearsdental.com is still yours (1-3 hours, owner).
2. Pick one domain, or register a new name, and stop linking to a dead one (1-3 hours).
3. Add the site link to the Google profile and correct Nextdoor, BizArchive and directory entries (2-4 hours, office manager).
4. Rebuild a small site: services, hours, insurance, map, tap-to-call, appointment request (8-20 hours, web person).
5. Turn on auto-renew, two-factor login and an expiry alert (1-2 hours).

## After the fix

Add an online appointment request. The Maps profile has no booking action and only a phone number, so the front desk absorbs every request.
